recognize_zh: 雙酯酶染色（combined esterase）下，絕大多數母細胞呈瀰漫紅棕色的非特異性酯酶（α-naphthyl butyrate）陽性，僅中央一顆較小細胞呈藍色（chloroacetate esterase 陽性，顆粒球系）；以單核球系為主的染色結果支持急性單核母細胞白血病。
features: Most leukocytes show diffuse red-brown cytoplasmic nonspecific (butyrate) esterase positivity
Staining intensity varies from strong to weak among the blasts
A single small cell stains blue with chloroacetate esterase, marking a granulocytic-lineage cell (internal control)
Only rare cells show double staining or are unstained
Red cells in the background are unstained apart from pale pink counterstain
describe_en: Combined esterase cytochemical stain on the peripheral blood shows that the large majority of leukocytes exhibit diffuse red-brown cytoplasmic alpha-naphthyl butyrate (nonspecific) esterase activity. A rare cell shows blue naphthol AS-D chloroacetate (specific) esterase staining, consistent with a granulocytic-lineage cell serving as an internal control. The predominance of nonspecific esterase-positive cells confirms monocytic lineage of the blasts. Findings support acute monoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: AMML shows substantial populations of both butyrate esterase-positive (red-brown) and chloroacetate esterase-positive (blue) cells, each at least 20% of marrow cells.
These may show focal, dot-like nonspecific esterase activity (alpha-naphthyl acetate) that is fluoride-resistant, not the diffuse fluoride-sensitive butyrate esterase of monocytes.
Granulocytic blasts are chloroacetate esterase and MPO positive (blue) with little or no butyrate esterase staining.
